purpose: UI concept exploration only; not production assets or gameplay changes

prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity desktop combat UI concept for HeroScript, a data-driven roguelike deckbuilder. Create ONE complete landscape 16:9 gameplay screen, NOT a dashboard, no device frame, no collage, no design agency slide. Practical implementable UI with confident art direction and excellent hierarchy. Gameplay anatomy: restrained top header with small ROUND 4, TIMELINE and PAUSE; very large clear battlefield containing one player silhouette on the left and two distinct enemy silhouettes on the right, each with understated health bar and clear attack-intent icons and numbers, not boxed character panels. Five readable portrait cards floating in a modest fan at the bottom, not inside a framed hand container. Each card has large name, one small Energy cost token, a simple bold abstract illustrative placeholder, a clean rules-text region, thin rarity border, no character target names in its effect. Use English card names STRIKE, CORROSION, CONDENSE, FLURRY, GUARD; short effects "Deal 8 damage.", "Apply 3 Corrosion.", "Consume stacks in one proc.", "10 damage split over 2 hits.", "Gain 8 Block." A small separate Action preview area below/beside the hand, plus compact DRAW 8 and DISCARD 5 indicators and a clearly prioritized END TURN button bottom-right. Character detail panel collapsed to a tiny right-edge chevron, no empty sidebar. Do not crowd the readable content.
MANDATORY DISTINCTIVE GRAPHIC MOTIF: bundles of 5-8 extremely thin, very closely spaced PARALLEL lines, like precisely drafted printed-circuit traces. Long straight horizontal/vertical sections change direction via clean 45-degree diagonal elbows, with tiny fillets only at the joints. Lines within each bundle follow the same path and maintain consistent narrow gaps through every bend. This motif is clearly visible along two or three screen margins, card art/title transitions and selected UI dividers, always low contrast around text, no random branching circuit motherboard wallpaper. Flat disciplined contours, asymmetric negative space, optical alignment, restrained small square/dot terminals. Avoid broad diagonal ribbons; these are tightly grouped fine strokes.
Constraints: sharp legible typography, accessible text size and contrast, intentionally original graphic identity. No luminous bloom, no thick neon wireframes, no blue-purple gradients, no glassmorphism, no repeated rounded dashboard tiles, no fake tiny technical text, no ornate golden fantasy frames, no ornamental circles behind every icon, no watermark. The screen should look like a credible designed game UI, not generic AI sci-fi output.
Concept 01 GRAPHITE / PRECISION. Palette: near-black graphite background, bone-white primary typography, desaturated gray secondary information, a single restrained pale teal interaction accent, rust red only for health/danger. Swiss typographic discipline, squared grotesk typography with narrow mono labels, almost invisible charcoal separators, crisp flat print-like geometry. Circuit bundles are graphite gray and occasional bone-white, highly precise, used as navigational/bracketing signatures. Battlefield understated dark architectural planes; characters use simple striking ink-cut silhouettes. Cards charcoal with bone-white rules and large spare woodcut-style geometric art placeholders. Screen has strong uncluttered hierarchy and dramatically open battlefield. Darkest, quietest, most technical direction.

Concept 02 IVORY / PRINTED CIRCUIT. Palette: warm off-white/ivory background, black ink primary typography, stone gray secondary, brick vermilion interaction accent. Bright editorial art direction, contemporary print poster meets technical diagram, subtle paper feel, not distressed parchment, not brown medieval UI. Larger crisp black type, fine typographic rules, cropped oversized simple geometric illustrative shapes. Mandatory closely packed thin parallel traces bend in 45-degree paths in black ink with tiny occasional vermilion terminals, like an elegant printed schematic. Cards ivory with black type, bold black/brick abstract art placeholders and thin restrained rarity borders. Characters strong ink/linocut silhouettes against extremely pale environment. Clear warm humane visual identity, maximal readability, minimal framing. Do NOT turn this into an office productivity app.

Concept 03 CARBON / COPPER ENGRAVING. Palette: dark warm coal/umber, cream typography, muted oxidized copper circuit strokes and restrained amber selected action. Industrial arcane character without steampunk gears or mechanical clutter. Typography sturdy condensed grotesk headings, generous readable humanist rules text. Physical understated brushed-carbon texture on only a few surfaces, crisp chamfered 45-degree corners, no bevels or glossy 3D buttons. Bundles of very fine close copper engraved traces run across selected margins and card title transitions with sharp 45-degree elbows and understated tiny terminals. Selected card border a flat thin warm copper, others subtle controlled rarity colors. Battlefield flat dusk/ash architecture with bold printed silhouettes, five tactile charcoal cards with cream text and abstract etching placeholders. More expressive and game-like than a sterile console while retaining measured hierarchy, sparse ornament and legibility.
